transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because of some stuff at work. I've just been... doing things that don't really make sense, I suppose. 

Like... lining up all the receipts across the floor instead of filing them. Or... tapping my calculator. Always in sets of nine. Sometimes I just... stand by the copier with my hands up in the air. Just standing there until someone asks if I'm alright. It's... yeah, that's why I'm here.
Do these behaviors feel like something you have to do, like if not doing them would lead to something bad happening?
No... not really. I don't... I don't think anything bad is going to happen. I just do it, I guess. I don't really know why.
Do these behaviors, like lining up receipts or tapping your calculator, happen because you have certain thoughts that keep coming into your mind that you can’t seem to get rid of?
No, I... I don't think so. It's not like that. I don't really have thoughts like that stuck in my head. I just... do it.
Do these behaviors help you feel less anxious or prevent something you’re worried about, even if you don’t have specific thoughts about it?

No... it's not about being anxious. Um, it doesn't really change how I feel or... prevent anything. 

Like I said, I just... I don't really know. I just do it.
Can you describe what goes through your mind just before you start doing these behaviors, like lining up receipts or tapping the calculator?

Um... nothing, really. I don't... my mind is just kind of blank, I guess. 

I'm usually just sitting at my desk... and then I'm doing it. I don't really notice beforehand.
Have you ever experienced things like hearing voices or seeing things that others don’t, or having beliefs that people around you say aren’t true?

Um... I guess sometimes. 

I don't really talk about it. But... sometimes when I'm alone, like at my desk or walking home, I hear... a voice. It's a man's voice. He just says things like, um, "check line seven" or... "you missed the sign." 

It sounds real. Like, clear enough that I look around to see who's talking. But... there's never anyone there.
Have there been times when you believed something strongly that others say isn’t true, even though you feel certain it is?

Um... yeah, I guess. 

I don't really like talking about it, because I know it sounds strange. But... sometimes at work, I get convinced that certain invoice totals... or account numbers and due dates... that they're messages about me. 

My supervisor, he shows me they're just normal entries. But... I don't know. I still feel like they're tracking whether I understand the pattern.

Can you tell me more about those messages you see in the invoice totals or account numbers? Do they mean something unusual or impossible, like messages from another dimension, or do they seem more like a hidden but normal kind of pattern?

Um... I don't know. 

I don't think it's... like, from another dimension or anything like that. It just feels like... a pattern. Like they're put there for me to notice. But I don't really know what they mean. 

I just... I don't know.
Do you believe that these patterns in the invoices or account numbers are part of some kind of system that others are using to communicate with you or monitor your actions?

Um... yeah, I guess. 

Like I said... even when my supervisor sits down and shows me they're just normal entries, I still get convinced they're messages about me. The invoice totals, the due dates... I just can't shake it. It really feels like they're tracking whether I understand the pattern. 

I don't really know who is doing it or... or how. Just... that they are.
How long have you been hearing the voice and believing that the invoice totals and account numbers are messages about you?

Um... I don't know exactly. It's been a while. 

Maybe... about eight months? Yeah, I guess it's been around eight months now... for both the voice and the stuff with the numbers.
Have you noticed any other experiences where you believe something is happening that others say isn’t real, or have you seen or heard things that others don’t seem to notice?

Um... I guess so. 

Just... sometimes I hear a voice. A man's voice. Usually when I'm just sitting at my desk, alone... or walking home. 

He just says things like... "check line seven," or... "you missed the sign." It sounds real. I always look around, but... there's never anyone there.
Have you ever had experiences where you felt completely certain about something that turned out to be completely untrue, even though it felt very real to you at the time?

Um... well, like I was saying before... about the numbers at work. 

I know it probably sounds strange, but... I just get so convinced that the invoice totals and the account numbers... and the due dates... that they're messages. About me. 

My supervisor, he... he sits down and shows me they're just normal entries. But... I still feel like they're tracking me. Like they want to see if I understand the pattern. It just... it feels completely real to me. Even when people say it isn't.

Have these experiences with the voice and the messages in numbers happened while you were feeling normal emotionally, or were you going through a period of feeling unusually down, depressed, or extremely energetic and restless at the time?

Um... I don't know if it always matches up. 

There was... a few weeks, maybe a month ago... I wasn't feeling too up or down. I was sleeping okay. Not like when I get really wired. But... I was still hearing him. And the numbers still felt like they meant something. So... I guess it happens even when I feel fine.
Have there ever been times when you experienced things like hearing voices or believing something strongly that others don’t, almost every day for weeks or even months at a time?
Um... yeah, I guess so. It's been... going on for a while. The voice and the... the numbers. Probably about eight months now, I think.
Have you noticed any changes in how well you can handle your work responsibilities, take care of yourself, or get along with others since these experiences started?

Um... yeah, I guess things have changed a bit. 

Work's been... harder. I used to just do the ledgers, but lately... they keep coming back with mistakes. Serious ones, I guess. I've had to ask for help with stuff that used to be easy for me. Just... can't seem to finish it on my own anymore. 

And, um... I was taking a course module for work, too, and... I failed it. So... yeah. Things aren't going great.
Have you noticed a significant drop in your ability to function at work, take care of yourself, or interact with others since these experiences started?

I... I think I just said that. Um... yeah. Work is just... it's not good. Like I mentioned, the ledgers have mistakes... big ones. I can't finish things I used to do easily without asking for help now. And... yeah, I failed that course module. So... I guess I'm not doing as well as I used to.

Have there been times when you experienced these kinds of things—like hearing the voice or seeing messages in numbers—for at least several months in a row without a break, even when your mood was stable and you weren’t feeling particularly down or up?

Um... yeah. I guess so. There was... a stretch of a few weeks, a little while back. I was actually sleeping pretty normally then. I didn't feel... you know, super energized or anything. Just kind of regular. 

But... yeah, I still heard the voice. And I still felt... pulled into the number patterns. So... it didn't stop.

Have you noticed any changes in your ability to take care of yourself or interact with others, like keeping up with personal hygiene, maintaining relationships, or doing everyday tasks around the house?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I still care about people and stuff. Just... I don't know. 

Most days I just let texts sit there. I don't really reply. And I usually skip hanging out with people after work. Even when my friends talk about things I used to like... you know, music shows or whatever... I just feel kind of flat about it. It's just... hard to care right now.
Have you noticed any changes in how you take care of yourself, like showering regularly, brushing your teeth, or dressing appropriately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I still shower and stuff. It's fine.
Have you had any trouble keeping up with basic self-care, like showering, brushing your teeth, or dressing appropriately, beyond what you already mentioned?
Um... no. Like I just said... it's fine. I get dressed for work and brush my teeth and everything. I don't really have trouble with that part.
